conditional_transaction: Validate strict request schema and logical id; BEGIN IMMEDIATE, then sample trusted current time.
Exact request retry returns immutable stored result before enforcing present-day latest-version gates, but uses a fresh current display envelope; changed request with same id is rejected.

Resolve current immutable thesis and explicit policy version from Store, capture snapshots/SHAs/first-save evidence. Expected thesis must equal raw latest and strict-current selected available thesis.

Resolve full same-company source DAG including quote parents; source and thesis receipt availability at current target is mandatory. Unrelated excluded older legacy versions do not by themselves invalidate a known current selected record.
Resolve position only from explicit declaration receipt; unknown position is unresolved, not flat.
Verify public information status/metadata plus all dependency reply assessments at trusted runtime; no historical input can evade a currently known hold.
Compute via evaluate_decision with frozen policy/thesis/quote and attributed assessment; no financial input or action is supplied by caller.

Persist request digest, full input snapshots and source bindings, dependency assessment versions, result and trusted first_saved_at atomically in separate immutable table; no thesis/policy/question/reply/classification/company writes.
existing_IR_plan_boundary: IR-plan compares hypothetical precommitted branch outcomes; it is not an actual public baseline record and must not substitute for registered policy/current thesis/explicit position/source-bound quote evaluation.

contents: selected thesis/source availability diagnostic and consumed dependency assessment versions
calculation input/result and explicit synthetic context
as_of/current calculation time separate from first_saved_at
basis.kind=saved_research and server-computed full-lineage IR/publicity boundary; no caller claim of public-only provenance
future_table_design.name: research_decision_reviews
future_table_design.no_new_request_receipt_table_required: The caller review id plus stored canonical request and digest provides same-request retry / same-id changed-request rejection. No implicit reuse of job request receipts.

optional_fields.synthetic: boolean default false; synthetic input and policy lineage cannot become real context

minimum_conditional_request.phase_one_temporal_contract: New writes evaluate at trusted current runtime only. Historical/retrospective analysis remains explicitly read-only; no new past-decision persistence mode in minimal scope.

assessment.evidence_ids: nonempty subset of selected thesis evidence IDs
assessment.rationale: why the public evidence supports this assessment
assessment.thesis_status: intact / invalidated / uncertain; reviewer assertion, never inferred from positive language

required_fields.decision_quote: existing source-bound quote object; may be empty for a saved unresolved result
required_fields.expected_thesis_version: must match both raw current and selected strict-current available thesis version
required_fields.id: caller-chosen stable logical review identity; unique within new public table
required_fields.policy_version: explicit immutable policy version, not automatically newest

not_claimed: No current real case input readiness or financial policy completeness assessed
No backtested performance, trading recommendation or current-price verification
No direct A1/D1 author endorsement of this schema
No availability gap or semantic validation solved by serializing a result

public_scope_boundary.public_only_lineage_definition: True only after complete transitive origin closure contains no ir_reply source and same-company public-information checks pass. Missing or held origins cannot establish public-only.
public_scope_boundary.with_IR_origin: An existing public_clarification IR ancestor is permitted under existing decision rules with explicit IR-origin basis and current dependency holds; never label it public-only.

recommendation.adopted_workflow_gap: docs/decision-policy.md already requires storing public-only evaluation separately from post-reply evaluation. Existing research outputs preserve proposals, but no route persists an actually evaluated source-bound public price baseline under fixed policy without a reply.
recommendation.financial_research_action_record: Existing research job result already stores proposed_action with full thesis_update under lease/CAS; calculate externally using pure decision if all inputs exist, record rationale/source references in standard result. This records research judgement but does not certify a source-bound persisted price decision.
recommendation.implementation_priority_boundary: Implementation remains a parent decision after reviewing this design; no code is added here. If the adopted formal public baseline is to be supported, a separate small table/current-view wrapper is useful and existing daily/ir-plan is not a complete substitute.
recommendation.independent_price_review_gap: Use a separate research_decision_reviews identity/table and thin wrapper around existing decision math for the adopted actual-baseline storage requirement. The route does not require a new/direct reply; preserve dependency holds for any prior IR ancestry.
recommendation.qualitative_public_assessments: Use existing immutable qualitative case/job progression. No price/model values needed.

recommended_name.purpose: A reply-independent saved-research price review; a genuine public-only baseline is a checked subset.

reuse.availability: Use existing thesis/source receipts; policy and new review use their own trusted first_saved_at. Do not extend RecordAvailability entity types merely to duplicate timestamps.
reuse.current_view: Reuse current quote timing and current thesis-version helper semantics in a separate public wrapper. Existing current_decision_view requires reply_id and cannot be called unchanged with an actual public record.
reuse.immutable_source_holds: dependency_source_information_holds and existing pure origin checks; include quote lineage in full check
reuse.positions: DecisionLifecycle.position_for or Store.declared_position_at, no import-derived held=false assumption
reuse.reply_dependency_holds: source_assessments with reply_id omitted still discovers source metadata.reply_id in full lineage; capture consumed versions, check runtime holds before INSERT

time_and_current_view.current_display: Recheck latest thesis version, saved thesis review due date, fixed-policy quote age, dependency information revisions and current explicit position; hold current action if any is unavailable/changed/due. Do not upgrade a historically unresolved result or recalculate a new review implicitly.
time_and_current_view.fresh_quote_new_review: new logical id, same chosen policy version if intended and current expected thesis; no reply reevaluation
time_and_current_view.historical_analysis: existing read-only Store.thesis_view mode=pit requires equal as_of/knowledge_at; mode=retrospective requires both cutoffs and explicit non-PIT label. Pure decision is calculation, not historic DB proof.
time_and_current_view.historical_raw: immutable stored result plus first_saved_at, never rewritten as current
time_and_current_view.new_write: current-time only in phase one, no caller backdating
time_and_current_view.policy_freeze: same explicit policy version/snapshot/hash stays fixed; later policy versions do not rewrite old reviews. Registration before decision is not proof that thresholds predated the market outcome.
